title: Quarterly strategy showcase + decision ladder for leadership sync (Q2 prep)
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Goal: Produce a concise (2-page) strategy showcase and an explicit decision ladder to support the leadership sync for Q2 planning. This artifact must surface: 1) initiative health signals mapped to OKRs, 2) three proposed investment adjustments by risk/impact, 3) open asks requiring exec commitment, and 4) fallback lanes if capacity or spend constraints arise.

Scope: cross-functional synthesis across Product, Eng, Research, and GTM. We will combine run-rate telemetry (console dashboards), initiative-level qualitative signals from PMs, and recent infra cost/latency trends to present a prioritized set of asks.

Success criteria: leadership can commit to a set of decisions in the sync without needing a follow-up workshop (i.e., no >2 outstanding asks). The showcase should be readable in 8 minutes and include one decision ladder that maps options to owner, timeline, and acceptance criteria.
